title: Turn back before distance hardens into pain
summary: The prayer becomes poor, meek, and direct — save me, because I am Yours. Naam is not decoration here; it is the support that keeps distance from hardening into another wound.
takeaway: Ask to be saved before distance teaches the heart to live wounded.
lifeApplication: The moment you know you are drifting, stop making the case for distance. Say plainly, 'I am Yours,' return to Naam, and let support arrive before the wound deepens.

source.shortMeaning: The humbled servant asks to be saved and takes Naam as the support where peace is found.
source.lifeApplication: When drifting becomes painful, return as one who belongs and let Naam hold the wound before it hardens.

evidence.coreClaim: The humbled servant asks to be saved and takes Naam as the support where peace is found.
evidence.turn: Distance stops being managed privately and becomes a meek prayer for rescue and support in Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: The moment you know you are drifting, stop making the case for distance. Say plainly, 'I am Yours,' return to Naam, and let support arrive before the wound deepens.
